subject: Request: Approval to include ClearForge demo clip in customer case study
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@clearforge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Approval to include ClearForge demo clip in customer case study

Hi Olivia,

Thanks again for the great session last month — the joint demo came across really well and customers at the webinar followed up with a bunch of inbound interest. Marissa (marketing) and I are drafting the short case study and would like to include a 45-second clip from the live demo where Ben shows the integration flow.

We want to make sure we have explicit permission for:
- Use of a 45s video clip in the landing page case study and in a 30s social cutdown
- Use of ClearForge logo and quote attribution ("ClearForge")
- Right to host the asset on our site and CDN for marketing (no expiry requested yet; happy to limit to 24 months if you'd prefer)

Attached: the clip we propose and a draft of the proposed release text. Can your legal team confirm whether the attached draft is sufficient or if you need an NDA/consent form? If helpful, we can send this through DocuSign for an approved sign-off.

Proposed timeline: we plan to publish the case study the week of Mar 15. Could we lock approval by end of day Mar 11?

Appreciate it — Neha

--
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0123

---

From: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@clearforge.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Matthews <ben.matthews@clearforge.com>, ClearForge Legal <legal@clearforge.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Approval to include ClearForge demo clip in customer case study

Neha — thanks for the note and congrats on the webinar traction. I forwarded this to our legal ops (cc'd) and looped Ben so he sees the clip. A couple quick points from product/brand side:
- The clip looks fine content-wise; we just need to confirm logo usage (we prefer the horizontal lockup) and that we have a short approval for the quote attribution.
- On retention: 24 months is preferable for us.

Legal, can you confirm what form you need from Redwood to sign-off? If it's a simple release we'll get it signed quickly.

Best,
Olivia
Director, GTM Partnerships
ClearForge

---

From: ClearForge Legal <legal@clearforge.com>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@clearforge.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 09:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Approval to include ClearForge demo clip in customer case study

Hi Olivia / Neha,

Thanks for sending the materials. We can approve the use of the clip and logo provided Redwood accepts a short release that covers:
1) The exact usage channels (web landing page, social media ads, and newsletter)
2) A 24-month hosting term
3) A confirmation that no customer PII is included in the clip
4) A single quote attribution we can review and request minor edits to (we will not add substantive wording changes without telling you)

I've attached a short PDF consent template (draft-customer-consent.pdf). Please fill in the blanks for the usage channels/dates and return; we will countersign. If you prefer, we can route via DocuSign (link below) for a faster turnaround.

Regards,
Legal Ops
ClearForge
legal@clearforge.com

Attachment: draft-customer-consent.pdf

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@clearforge.com>, ClearForge Legal <legal@clearforge.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Approval to include ClearForge demo clip in customer case study

Thanks, Legal and Olivia — attaching our proposed release text and the exact channels to populate into your consent template. Quick notes:
- We'll host the clip on redwood.ai/case-studies/clearforge and embed the mp4 via our CDN.
- Social cutdown will be a 30s edit for LinkedIn/Twitter and may run as an organic post plus a paid boost (same creative, no additional customer quote).
- Proposed quote (from Ben's webinar message): "Redwood made our inference pipeline reliable and 3x cheaper in production." Please flag any wordsmithing needed — we can swap to a shorter tagline.

I've attached proposed-release-text.docx and the video file itself for clarity. If Legal can countersign the attached PDF or send the DocuSign over by EOD tomorrow (Mar 11), we can hit the Mar 15 publish target.

Thanks — Marissa
Head of Marketing, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0199

Attachment: proposed-release-text.docx, clearforge-demo-45s-clip.mp4

Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 16:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Approval to include ClearForge demo clip in customer case study

All — quick confirmation from account team side: Ben is happy with the proposed quote and the 24-month term. Olivia, if Legal is OK with the draft, I can send the countersigned copy to your procurement team once we have signatures.

If Legal needs any minor edits to the quote for clarity, let's keep changes to non-substantive phrasing only. Otherwise we are green to go.

Thanks,
Rishi

rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 (628) 555-0110
